parameters.content:
## Crexi Commercial Property Listings & Pricing Extractor

**Actor:** [Crexi Commercial Property Listings & Pricing Extractor](https://apify.com/dataspryva/crexi-commercial-property-listings-and-pricing)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/crexi-commercial-property-listings-and-pricing-extractor.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `propertyUrls` (array)
- `transactionTypes` (array)
- `searchTerms` (array)
- `propertyTypes` (array)
- `subtypes` (array)
- `locations` (array)
- `cities` (array)
- `counties` (array)
- `zipCodes` (array)
- `minPrice` (integer)
- `maxPrice` (integer)
- `minPricePerSqft` (number)

### Output fields
- `name` (Property Name)
- `transaction_type` (Kind)
- `property_type` (Type)
- `city` (City)
- `state` (State)
- `price` (Price)
- `cap_rate` (Cap Rate %)
- `net_operating_income` (NOI)
- `building_sqft` (Building SqFt)
- `broker_names` (Brokers)
- `property_url` (URL)

description: Crexi commercial property listings scraper: runs the Crexi Commercial Property Listings & Pricing Extractor Apify Actor, returns name, transaction_type, property_type, price, net_operating_income and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
